Features.title: One Platform,
Features.subtitle: InternLink provides tailored tools for students, coordinators, supervisors, and administrators — all working together seamlessly.

roles.studentsDesc: Submit weekly plans, upload presentations, and track your internship progress through a personalized dashboard with real-time feedback.
roles.coordinatorsDesc: Easily match students with verified companies and manage thousands of placements with comprehensive institutional oversight and analytics.
roles.supervisorsDesc: Review weekly tasks, mark attendance, and generate officially stamped final performance reports with just a few clicks.
roles.adminDesc: Manage university settings, onboard new companies, verify institutions, and ensure data integrity across the entire ecosystem.

HowItWorks.title: From Registration to
HowItWorks.subtitle: We've simplified the internship lifecycle into four clear phases, ensuring transparency for students and efficiency for coordinators.

steps.step1Desc: Universities and Companies register by uploading stamped verification proposals to ensure a secure network.
steps.step2Desc: Coordinators match students to verified companies based on department and available internship slots.
steps.step3Desc: Students submit weekly plans while supervisors provide real-time feedback and attendance tracking.
steps.step4Desc: Final performance reports are automatically generated with official digital stamps for academic records.
